grades.quote: The hart will then execute the trap handler, which will eventually resume execution at or after the original trapped instruction in U-mode.
grades.reason: The passage is a general introduction to privilege levels and trap types. It says a trap handler eventually resumes execution at or after the trapped instruction. It never mentions SRET, sstatus fields (SPP, SPIE, SIE), sepc, or the privilege mode and pc restored, so it gives only background context.
